messages.author: Alex Chen
messages.content: hey, did you see the PR for the etcd sharding change?

messages.author: Jesse Jaggars
messages.content: yeah, looking at it now. the partition key logic seems right but I'm not sure about the migration path

messages.author: Alex Chen
messages.content: agreed. we should probably add a feature gate for the rollout. I've been looking at how the kube-apiserver handles similar migrations

messages.author: Jesse Jaggars
messages.content: makes sense. let me check what the operator upgrade path looks like

messages.author: Alex Chen
messages.content: also wanted to mention — the CI is flaky on the e2e tests again. same timeout issue from last week

messages.author: Jesse Jaggars
messages.content: ugh. which test suite?

messages.author: Alex Chen
messages.content: the hosted control plane provisioning tests. timeout waiting for the hosted cluster to become available

messages.author: Jesse Jaggars
messages.content: I'll take a look. might be the webhook cert rotation issue we saw before

messages.author: Alex Chen
messages.content: could be. the cert-manager pod was restarting in the last failure

messages.author: Jesse Jaggars
messages.content: let me check the prow logs

messages.author: Alex Chen
messages.content: thanks. oh btw, are you going to the team offsite next month?

messages.author: Jesse Jaggars
messages.content: yeah planning on it. should be good to catch up with everyone in person

messages.author: Priya Patel
messages.content: quick question about the ROSA boundary project — do we have the updated architecture diagram?

messages.author: Jesse Jaggars
messages.content: I think Sam updated it last week. check the Drive folder

messages.author: Priya Patel
messages.content: found it, thanks. The SSO integration section looks different from what we discussed

messages.author: Jesse Jaggars
messages.content: yeah we pivoted to using the existing IAM provider instead of standing up a new one

messages.author: Priya Patel
messages.content: makes sense. I'll update the requirements doc to match

messages.author: Jesse Jaggars
messages.content: perfect, lmk if you need anything else

messages.author: Dana Kim
messages.content: PSA: we're seeing elevated error rates on the staging cluster after the latest operator deploy

messages.author: Alex Chen
messages.content: which operator? I deployed the control-plane-operator update this morning

messages.author: Dana Kim
messages.content: that's the one. the webhook is returning 500s intermittently

messages.author: Jesse Jaggars
messages.content: checking the logs now

messages.author: Alex Chen
messages.content: found it — there's a nil pointer in the admission handler when the HCP doesn't have annotations yet

messages.author: Dana Kim
messages.content: good catch. can you push a fix?

messages.author: Alex Chen
messages.content: already on it, PR incoming

messages.author: Jesse Jaggars
messages.content: nice, I'll review once it's up

messages.subject: Re: Q3 OKR alignment — platform team
messages.body_snippet: Updated the shared doc with our proposed OKRs. Key change: moved 'multi-cluster observability' from stretch to committed based on the RHOBS progress. Please review by Friday.
